_comment: Price grid of the LLM routes, euros per million tokens (input, cache read, output). Keys are <provider>/<model>; <provider>/* covers every model of a route. A null price means 'to be provided': the core refuses the turn, it never counts it as 0. Source for deepseek-v4.1-flash: Scaleway invoice of November 2026 (relais grid scaleway-2026-11). glm-5.3 and qwen3.8-27b: Scaleway console, read by Stephane on 12/11/2026; the console shows no cache price for glm-5.3, so its cache read is priced as its input, on the safe side.
